answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A nectar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
